_note: TutorialOverlay's own words (card, tray, settings). {0}, {1}: values put in; keep them. A key left out is shown in English.
Review: Repeating this step — press Done to continue.
ScrollIssue: The spot is outside the window — {0}.
ScrollFind: Scroll the window to bring the spot into view.
ScrollHereAny: Scroll here — I'll spot the place
IssueDialog: Close the "{0}" window first — the app ignores clicks while it is open.
PrepareText: The app has the "{0}" window open. Answer or close it — the app ignores clicks while it is open. Then we carry on.
DialogMark: Answer or close this window first
PrepareTextCover: The "{0}" window is open over the app. Close it — then we start.
CoverText: The "{0}" window covers what this step needs. Close or move it — then we carry on.
IssueCover: The "{0}" window covers the spot — close or move it.
CantFind: I can't find where to click
DontGet: I don't get what to do
OtherHint: Enter — send · Shift+Enter — new line · Esc — cancel
SketchTitle: Circle the part of the screen you mean
SketchDoneTip: Done: the picture goes with the question
ChatHello: What isn't working on this step? Write, or mark it on the screen.
ChatHint: Enter — send · Esc — back to the step
ReplyElsewhere: The assistant's answer waits on step {0} — go back there with Back
OutroSavedText: It is in your library: replay it any time from the tray icon menu (Tutorials).
OutroChangedText: The lesson was fixed on the way to match your screen. Save it so it runs this way next time.
OutroOverwriteText: The old “{0}” in your library will be replaced by the repaired one.
AskHint: Enter — send · Shift+Enter — new line · Esc — close
TrayAgentNever: No requests from the agent yet
TrayCopyCommand: Copy the command for the agent
AlreadyRunning:
TutorialOverlay is already running: 127.0.0.1:{0} (PID {1}).

Its icon is in the notification area; a second server is not needed.
TrayExitConfirm: A tutorial is running. Quit TutorialOverlay anyway?
SetPortNote: A new port takes effect after Save and a restart. Then press "For the agent" and give the command to the agent — it reconnects by itself.
SetForAgentNote: A claude mcp add command for all projects. The agent finds the port and the key itself, so the command stays right after a port change. Run it in a terminal (or paste it to the agent in chat).
RestartBusy: Port {0} is already in use ({1}). The server was not restarted and keeps running on {2}.
SetAutoColor: Match mark colour to the app
SetHideInactive: Hide marks while the app is not in front
SetHideCapture: Hide the overlay from screenshots and screen recording
SetCursorBadge: An “auto” tag beside the pointer while autoplay moves it
SetAutoSpeedNote: How fast autoplay moves the mouse and goes on to the next step. It always waits as long as the app needs to answer.
SetKeysNote: Click a field and press a chord (with Ctrl, Alt or Win). Backspace or Delete turns it off.
SetRestartAsk:
The port is now {0}. Restart the server now?

The agent will have to reconnect to the new address.
SetAfterTutorial: Saved. Colour and language apply after the current tutorial.
HelpVisible: Click «{0}» — it is framed, highlighting it now.
HelpAgentToo: The assistant will look too and say more.
HelpAgentIdle: The assistant isn't following the lesson right now: to get its answer, write "help" to it in the chat — it will see the step and your question.
ContinueUnheard: The assistant isn't following the lesson right now. Write "continue" to it in the chat: it will see you pressed this button and prepare the next lesson.
AgentOn: The assistant is here: Help reaches it at once
AgentOff: The assistant is away — write to it in the chat
AgentOffFor: The assistant has been away {0} min — write to it in the chat
AgentOffContinue: To keep learning, write "continue" to the assistant in the chat
HelpSent: Told the assistant — a hint is coming.
IssueMinimized: The window is minimized — restore it.
IssueMissing: Can't find the element on screen.
IssueClosed: It was in a menu or window that is closed now — open it again.
IssueClosedIn: It is in the "{0}" window — open it first.
IssueOpenPrevious: I can't see "{0}". If it is in a menu or window, open "{1}" again first.
ReopenText: "{0}" was in a menu or window that has closed. Open it again: click "{1}".
IssueNotAnswering: The app is not answering right now — close the open menu (Esc) and I'll find the spot.
IssueElevated: The app runs as administrator — start TutorialOverlay as administrator too, or I can't see your clicks in it.
AutoIntro: I will move your mouse. Move it yourself and control is yours again. Buttons that cannot be undone (paying, deleting) are only ever pressed by you.
AutoStarting: Starting in {0}… take your hand off the mouse
AutoActing: Showing step {0} of {1} · move the mouse and I stop
AutoActingAgent: The assistant is showing you, as you asked · move the mouse and I stop
AutoStepDone: Step done. Carry on yourself, or press Do this step.
AutoLooking: Looking for “{0}”… · move the mouse and I stop
AutoAskedAgent: I can't see “{0}”, so I asked the assistant and am waiting for an answer · move the mouse and I stop
AutoFinished: Shown to the end. Go through it yourself now — that's how it sticks.
AutoRepeatSelf: Do it myself from the start
DangerCard: This cannot be undone — {0}. Check before you press it.

AutoReasons.user_took_over: You moved the mouse while I was moving the pointer.
AutoReasons.user_active: You were using the mouse or keyboard, so I didn't take over.
AutoReasons.danger: This step: {0}. I don't press it: check and press it yourself, then I can carry on.
AutoReasons.choice: This choice is yours — then I can carry on.
AutoReasons.cant_do: Do this step yourself — then I can carry on.
AutoReasons.password: Type the password yourself — I never touch it.
AutoReasons.app_inactive: The lesson's window went to the background.
AutoReasons.modal: The “{0}” window opened — decide what to press in it.
AutoReasons.no_close: The “{0}” window is in the way and I can't find its close button.
AutoReasons.target_missing_asked: I can't find “{0}” and the assistant hasn't helped yet. Do the step yourself or press “I can't find it”.
AutoReasons.wrong_window: Another window is where “{0}” should be.
AutoReasons.no_effect: I pressed it, but the app didn't respond.
AutoReasons.not_completed: I pressed it, but the app didn't respond.
AutoReasons.loop: The lesson keeps taking me back.
AutoReasons.elevated: This window runs as administrator — Windows doesn't let me press anything in it. Press it yourself.
AutoReasons.input_blocked: Windows blocked my input (the lock screen or a permission prompt).
